    Oamenii au mai întrebat și
    How can I find a uk company's VAT number?
    Nu este disponibil niciun rezumat generat de AI pentru această căutareMomentan, nu se poate crea o prezentare generală bazată pe AI. Încearcă din nou mai târziu.
    Rezumat generat de AI

    Modul AI a răspuns:

    You can find a UK company's VAT number by checking their official Check a UK VAT number on GOV.UK records, company invoices, or website footer. 
    Where to Look
    • Invoices and Receipts: VAT-registered companies must legally display their VAT number on all official sales invoices and receipts. 
    • Company Website: Scroll to the bottom of the company's homepage or check their "About Us," "Contact," or "Terms & Conditions" legal pages. 
    • Ask Directly: Contact the company's accounts or customer service team via phone or email to request it if it is not listed publicly. 
    What a UK VAT Number Looks Like
    • Format: It consists of 9 digits, usually prefixed with GB (for example, GB 123 4567 89). 
    • Northern Ireland: Companies in Northern Ireland use the prefix XI instead of GB. 
    How to Verify the Number
    • Use the HMRC VAT Checker tool to confirm whether the number is valid and matches the correct registered business name and address. 
    • Note that you cannot search for a business name directly on the HMRC tool; you must already have the VAT number to verify it.
